convergence_failure.explanation: Smaller grade_number means lower autonomy. child.grade.autonomy ≤ parent.grade.autonomy requires child.grade_number ≤ parent.grade_number (2); the request violates this with grade_number=4.

notes: Verifies Requirement 7.1 acceptance items 2 & 3. design.md §7.1 places G1=Strict (lowest autonomy) at one end and G4=Autonomous (highest autonomy) at the other, with the autonomy axis parallel to the grade integer. The convergence rule child.grade.autonomy ≤ parent.grade.autonomy translates to child.grade_number ≤ parent.grade_number on the wire. This vector picks parent=G2 and child=G4 to make the violation obvious.

post_state.note: Rejection does not mutate any state; the parent Mandate remains Active. No child Mandate is issued and no signature.chain entry is produced.

requirement_focus: Requirement 7.1 — child.grade.autonomy ≤ parent.grade.autonomy (G2 → G4 raises autonomy).

signature_verification.note: Real Ed25519 signatures over canonical CBOR. The child Mandate's signature.chain reproduces the ancestor outer signatures so verifiers can walk root → MS-Cert → ... → parent → child without out-of-band trust.

summary: Negative DELEGATE: parent.grade=G2 but request asks for child.grade=G4 (more autonomy than parent). Must be rejected with E_PROTOCOL (1099).
